title: Boss Battle: Grammar Boss
description: Verb Bot встречает Grammar Boss! Победи его в финальной битве: пройди 6 вызовов и составь план школьной поездки.

challenges.title: Первый удар
challenges.sentence: Verb Bot is play games every evening.
options: Verb Bot plays games every evening.
Verb Bot is playing games every evening.
Verb Bot play games every evening.
challenges.answer: Verb Bot plays games every evening.
challenges.wrongExplanation: «Every evening» — это Present Simple: у he / she / it глагол получает окончание -s, а is здесь лишний.

challenges.title: Магический вопрос
challenges.prompt: Составь вопрос из слов: the robot • is • working • now
challenges.wrongExplanation: Вопрос в Present Continuous начинается с is, потом подлежащее the robot, а в конце working now.

challenges.title: Полный ответ
options: I played football with my friends yesterday.
I play football with my friends yesterday.
I am playing football with my friends yesterday.
challenges.answer: I played football with my friends yesterday.
challenges.wrongExplanation: «Yesterday» — это прошлое: нужен Past Simple, глагол с окончанием -ed (play → played).

challenges.title: Эхо прошлого
options: We visited the museum last Sunday.
We visit the museum every Sunday.
We will visit the museum next Sunday.
challenges.answer: We visited the museum last Sunday.
challenges.wrongExplanation: «Last Sunday» — маркер прошлого: Past Simple, глагол с окончанием -ed (visit → visited).

challenges.title: Прямо сейчас
challenges.prompt: Выбери предложение о том, что происходит прямо сейчас
options: The students are listening to the teacher now.
The students listen to the teacher every day.
The students listened to the teacher yesterday.
challenges.answer: The students are listening to the teacher now.
challenges.wrongExplanation: «Now» — прямо сейчас: Present Continuous, am / is / are + глагол с -ing.

challenges.title: Взгляд в будущее
options: Tomorrow we will go to the zoo.
Yesterday we went to the zoo.
We go to the zoo every Sunday.
challenges.answer: Tomorrow we will go to the zoo.
challenges.wrongExplanation: «Tomorrow» — это будущее: will + глагол (go → will go).

finalPlan.intro: You are planning a school trip. Decide where to go, what to take, what you did to prepare and what you will do there.

sentences.text: The school trip starts at eight o'clock in the morning.
Our teacher gives us a map of the city.
We take sandwiches and juice for the trip.
Yesterday we bought tickets for the museum.
We prepared our backpacks last night.
Last week we discussed the trip with our teacher.
We will visit the History Museum in the afternoon.
Tomorrow we will take photos near the river.
Is the museum far from the bus stop?
We will not forget our water bottles.
